description: Lists the countries that match a legal model and/or a status on one question, optionally within a region. For questions like "Where is prostitution legal?" (model), "Where is buying sex a crime?" (topic buying, status illegal) or "Where are brothels legal in Europe?" (topic brothels, status legal and regulated, region europe).

model.description: Legal models to match (any of): decriminalisation (Decriminalisation), regulation (Regulation (legal & licensed)), abolitionism (Legal, organisation banned), neo-abolitionism (Buying criminalised (Nordic model)), prohibition (Selling and buying prohibited).

region.description: Limit to one region: europe (Europe), north-america (North America), latin-america (Latin America & Caribbean), middle-east (Middle East & North Africa), africa (Sub-Saharan Africa), asia (Asia), oceania (Oceania).

status.description: Statuses to match on `topic` (any of): legal (Legal), regulated (Legal under licence / registration), restricted (Legal with restrictions), illegal (Illegal), varies (Varies by region). Requires `topic`.

topic.description: The question `status` refers to: selling (selling sexual services), buying (buying sexual services), brothels (brothels and managed venues), sharedPremises (sex workers sharing premises), procuring (third parties profiting (procuring / pimping)), advertising (advertising sexual services), platforms (online platforms and ad sites), street (street-based sex work and soliciting), registration (registration, licensing and health checks), tax (tax and social security), migrants (migrant sex workers).

name: find_countries
title: Find countries by legal approach
